claim_text: High-dose biotin can interfere with certain laboratory assays and produce misleading results, including some cardiac and endocrine tests; supplement use should be disclosed to clinicians and laboratories before testing.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People taking biotin supplements before laboratory testing.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Biotin fact sheet describes laboratory assay interference.
limitations: Do not advise stopping prescribed treatment; follow laboratory/clinician instructions on timing.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
